# ClaimSaver+

> Self-help software for Florida motor-vehicle no-fault (PIP) claims. You prepare the paperwork and send it to your insurer. Flat $499 one time, per filer. Not a law firm. Not legal advice.

## Product

- Name: ClaimSaver+ platform access
- Price: $499 USD one time, per filer
- What it is: Guided PIP worksheets, document vault, reminders, and education so you can file your own Florida no-fault claim
- What it is not: A law firm, public adjuster, or anyone who files, negotiates, or speaks to the insurer for you
- Clinic dashboard: separate staff-software subscription; price is discussed in a 15-minute demo
